original_test_intent: Sustain approved CPU, memory, GPU and network full load for eight hours and verify the SUT remains error-free, responsive and free of hang or blue screen.
original_method: Bind licensed BurnInTest and immutable workload config, preserve baseline, run the four-subsystem profile for 480 minutes on a dedicated SUT under continuous telemetry/error monitoring, then collect complete results and final health.
manual_activity: The owner supplies/approves the licensed workload and safety envelope; an operator confirms full-load coverage and retains emergency abort/recovery authority for the eight-hour window.
required_inputs: Licensed BurnInTest binary and immutable configuration
safety_requirements: Abort on limits, XID, ECC/PCIe, network loss, hang, blue screen or reset
Do not accept narrow grep as full log review
agent_execution_scope: Run approved profile only after confirmation
Collect complete telemetry and raw logs for eight hours
Abort on gates and compare final health without verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: BurnInTest direction is applicable, but an operator-set variable, insecure SSH and last-30-line grep are insufficient to prove the fixed eight-hour run or complete error history.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the approved immutable BurnInTest configuration for exactly 480 minutes with complete timestamped workload and safety telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Eight hours, CPU/memory/GPU/network full load, no-error/no-hang/no-blue-screen criteria, script and 30/480-minute fields remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run baseline, immutable four-subsystem workload, continuous abort monitoring and full post-health comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds license/config provenance, objective load proof, complete evidence and recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Task Manager or a log tail alone cannot prove sustained four-subsystem coverage or absence of earlier errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Eight-hour combined load can expose or worsen thermal, power, memory, GPU, network and firmware faults.

project_override_considerations: Alternative tools need a documented equivalence matrix for all four subsystems and the full 480-minute duration; any uncovered workload or visual-only confirmation must be recorded.
expected_evidence: Complete eight-hour BurnIn raw output and per-subsystem utilization timeline
Continuous sensors, power, ECC/PCIe/GPU/network and BMC/OS events
Post-run health, final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1524 consistently defines eight-hour BurnIn. The same-code health-LED row is an independent physical variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: License, workload, limits and recovery are finite supplyable inputs, enabling conditional execution.

review_improvement: Strengthens the aligned DeepSeek direction with fixed-duration configuration provenance, continuous safety evidence and complete four-subsystem coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Long-run stability cannot be inferred from final status or a truncated log. The evidence must demonstrate sustained load on every named subsystem and preserve the complete temporal record, while a human owns the risk envelope and abort decisions.
